predeclared_discriminator: Bounded foundational-source inventory only. Inspect the authoritative ECCC TR25-033 source statements already bound in the fibre and the four named foundational ancestry items cited for the Section-3/3.4 fusion formulation (Razborov 1989, Karchmer 1993, Wigderson 1993, Nakayama-Maruoka 1995). For every located primary-source theorem or exact source statement materially connected to the cover/fusion interface, record source identity, exact object/model, assumptions, conclusion, dependence on t or circuit/intersection resource, and a DifferenceWitness to the current shared integral full-semifilter cover object. Classify MATCH only if an already-stated theorem either concerns the exact shared integral t-pair cover/cyclic system or has an explicit assumption-preserving translation to it, and gives a universal bound by a function of t on a source-defined shared-system coordinate that survives integrality, common-resource multiplexing, full noncanonical semi-filter obligations, and cheap-target controls. Classify NO_RELEVANT_SOURCE_BOUND only if all five bounded source families are actually inspected from primary-source content and no theorem satisfies every condition. Classify CANNOT_CHECK if any required primary source cannot be inspected well enough to support the bounded-family completeness claim. Do not define a new mathematical quantity or candidate. Outcome mapping is frozen: MATCH->SUCCESS; NO_RELEVANT_SOURCE_BOUND->FAILURE; CANNOT_CHECK->BLOCKED.
